findings.description: The note identifies the conjugated form abre as an -ir verb. The infinitive naming that verb is abrir; abre is its third-person singular present indicative form.

items.reviewerAnswer: Abre/cierra are singular present forms; abren/cierran are plural. Está abierto/cerrado describes a state.

findings.description: The policy deliberately leaves a reviewed acceptable Peninsular construction unaccepted. When the prompt does not explicitly require de, the natural variant with por answers it correctly.
findings.suggestion: Accept reviewed por variants when they satisfy the prompt. Alternatively, explicitly require the model with de in exercises assessing that particular form.
